title: B 454 OD Neukirchen
description: In einer Gemeinschaftsmaßnahme der Bundesrepublik Deutschland, des Landes Hessen, der Stadt Neukirchen und der Stadtwerke Neukirchen wird die Ortsdurchfahrt (OD) Neukirchen der B 454 auf einer Länge von rd. 2.060 m grundhaft erneuert. Die Vergabe erfolgt durch den Magistrat der Stadt Neukirchen im Namen und für Rechnung der vorgenannten Maßnahmenträger. Die Maßnahme umfasst im Wesentlichen: - den Vollausbau der Fahrbahn der B 454 zwischen dem westlichen Ortseingang und dem östlichen Bauende, - den Umbau des innerörtlichen Knotenpunktes B 454 / L 3156 zu einem kleinen Kreisverkehrsplatz, - den Um- und Ausbau der Bahnhofstraße (OD der L 3156) von der Einmündung B 454 bis zur UF Grenff sowie eine Deckensanierung zwischen der UF Grenff und der Einmündung Elsebeetweg, - den barrierefreien Ausbau der Nebenanlagen sowie den barrierefreien Umbau von drei Bushaltestellen mit insgesamt sechs Haltepunkten, - die Erneuerung der Mischwasserkanalisation einschließlich der Hausanschlussleitungen bis zur Grundstücksgrenze, den Ersatzneubau der Regenüberlaufbauwerke Bahnhofstraße und Hersfelder Straße und die Herstellung des Schachtbauwerks KM50810, - die Erneuerung der Trinkwasserleitung einschließlich der Hausanschlussleitungen bis zur Grundstücksgrenze, - die Herstellung einer Winkelstützwand mit Absturzsicherung entlang des Mühlgrabens, - die Erneuerung der Beschilderung und Markierung, - die Erneuerung der Lichtsignalanlagen und der Straßenbeleuchtung, - die Abstimmung des Bauablaufs mit den Versorgungsträgern und die bauseitige Unterstützung bei Leitungsverlegungen einschließlich der Mitverlegung von Leerrohren sowie - den Ersatzneubau des Bauwerks UF Urbach.

title: Rahmenvereinbarung für das Dienstradleasing der Stadt Delmenhorst
description: Die Stadt Delmenhorst möchte eine Rahmenvereinbarung über das Leasing von Fahrrädern für seine ca. 1430 Mitarbeitenden abschließen. Die Stadt Delmenhorst bietet ihren Tarifbeschäftigten bereits seit dem 01.01.2023 die Möglichkeit ein Dienstfahrrad im Wege der Entgeltumwandlung zur dienstlichen sowie privaten Nutzung. Damit das Angebot des Dienstradleasing weiterhin bereitgestellt werden kann, soll im Rahmen einer Folgeausschreibung eine Anbieterin bzw. ein Anbieter (Kooperation aus Service-Dienstleistenden mit Fachhandelnden, Leasinggebenden und Versicherungsdienstleistenden) gefunden werden. Die Stadt Delmenhorst stellt dabei die Leasingnehmerin dar, welche den Beschäftigten und Beamten das Dienstrad zur Verfügung stellt. Eine Rahmenvereinbarung soll dabei den Leasinginhalt darstellen, die die Bereitstellung von Fahrrädern im Wege des Leasings (Teilamortisationsleasing) zum Zwecke der Überlassung an die Beschäftigten und Beamten zur dienstlichen und privaten Nutzung einschließlich Versicherungs-, Schulungs- und Serviceleistungen, insbesondere die Abwicklung der Bestell-, Rückgabe- und Schadenabwicklungsprozesse, Wartung und Reparatur, Störfallmanagement und Bereitstellung eines Online-Portals beinhalten. Die Rahmenvereinbarung schließt die Auftraggeberin mit der Auftragnehmerin bzw. dem Auftragnehmer. Die im Rahmen eines Angebots gemachten finanziellen Konditionen, insbesondere die Leasingrate inkl. Versicherung sowie (teils optionalem) Service- und Versicherungspaket, werden für die Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung fest und verbindlich vereinbart. Die Auftraggeberin schließt auf Grundlage der Rahmenvereinbarung Einzelleasingverträge für die Beschäftigten und Beamten mit der Auftragnehmerin bzw. dem Auftragnehmer ab. Entsprechende Nutzungs- und Überlassungsverträge mit den Rechten und Pflichten der Beschäftigten sowie Beamten werden zwischen diesen und der Auftragnehmerin bzw. dem Auftragnehmer vereinbart. Die Nutzungs- und Überlassungsverträge regeln zudem die Entgeltumwandlung. Die Auftragnehmerin bzw. der Auftragnehmer koordiniert nach Maßgabe der Leistungsbeschreibung die Gesamtleistung und wickelt diese einheitlich ab.

title: Espoon Asunnot Oy / Kipparinkuja 1 peruskorjaus
description: Espoon Asunnot Oy / Kipparinkuja 1 peruskorjaus Hanke käsittää Espoon Kivenlahdessa osoitteessa Kipparinkuja 1 Espoo sijaitsevien asuinkerrostalojen peruskorjauksen. Rakennushankkeessa peruskorjataan laajasti vuonna 1977 rakennettu asuinkerrostalo, kahdeksan porrashuoneen neljä - yhdeksänkerroksinen asuinkerrostalo kellarikerroksella. Myös tontin piha-alueet kunnostetaan. Työt käsittävät kaikki tavanomaiseen peruskorjaukseen kohdentuvat rakennustyöt. Rakennustyö sisältää maanrakennus-, piha-, parveke/julkisivu-, hissi-, ja sisärakennus- sekä talotekniikkatöitä. Julkisivujen ulkokuoret puhdistetaan, salaojia + lämpöputkia uusitaan, parvekkeet korjataan, vesiputkia uusitaan, ikkunat ja parvekeovet uusitaan, hissit uusitaan, pihoja uusitaan sekä huoneistot ja talotekniikkaa uusitaan. Kohteeseen rakennetaan myös maalämpöjärjestelmä. Kohde tullaan toteuttamaan vaiheittain kolmessa vaiheessa. Urakoitsijan on saatava edellinen vaihe valmiiksi ennen seuraavan aloitusta. Vaiheistus on esitetty tarjouspyynnön liitteessä (vaiheistussuunnitelma). Huoneistot ja liiketilat tyhjennetään vaiheittain peruskorjausta varten. Portaat F-G-H tyhjennetään vuokralaisista 31.10.2026 mennessä. Muiden talojen tyhjennysaikataulun ilmoittaa urakoitsija tarjouksessaan. vuokralaiset täytyy irtisanoa vähintään 7kk ennen talojen tyhjennystä. Jokaisen vaiheen valmistuttua muuttavat vuokralaiset takaisin valmistuneisiin asuntoihin. Vaiheistus: Vaihe 1: Porrashuoneet H,G ja F Vaihe 2: Porrashuoneet E,D ja C Vaihe 3: Porrashuoneet A ja B Urakoitsija päättää missä vaiheessa piha-alueen työt tehdään. Rakennushankkeen suunnittelijat, suunnittelun jakautuminen, sijainti ja tarkemmat paljoustiedot on esitetty urakkaohjelmassa. Rakennuttaja pyrkii siihen, että urakkasopimukset voidaan tehdä mahdollisimman pian urakkakilpailun päättymisestä ja rakennustyöt alkaisivat joulukuussa 2026 edellyttäen kuitenkin, että Espoon Asunnot Oy:n hallitus on hyväksynyt hankkeen, tehdystä hankintapäätöksestä ei valiteta ja rakentamislupa on myönnetty. Kiinteistöön pääsee tutustumaan paikan päällä 17.11.2026 klo 12:00 sekä 18.11.2026 Klo 10:00.,

title: France – Tents – Acquisition de systèmes de décontamination au profit de petits détachements et prestations associées
description: L’objet du marché est l’acquisition de systèmes de décontamination de petits détachements (SDPD). L’objet du marché est l’acquisition de systèmes de décontamination de petits détachements (SDPD). Un système est constitué d’un ensemble d’éléments mobiles, modulables et cohérentes, permettant la décontamination approfondie d’un petit détachement de 6 à 12 personnels et de son matériel en toute autonomie. Le système de décontamination est décomposé en d’une part, un « cœur système » et d’autre part, des matériels et consommables pour son exploitation. Le « cœur système », pour être fonctionnel, est constitué a minima d’une tente metallotextile avec bulle de protection NRBC, d’une source mobile d’énergie conditionnée en caisse de transport, de douches mobiles, de tuyauteries et de réservoirs souples pour la fourniture d’eau propre et la récupération des effluents, et d’un mât d’éclairage extérieur et d’éclairages intérieurs et des équipements réparables. L’autre partie du système est constitué de l’ensemble des petits équipements et consommables nécessaires pour établir un chantier de décontamination : mobiliers mobiles, petits matériels de décontamination et consommables associés. Le système doit d’être projetable par voie aérienne. ----- La présente consultation est décomposée en deux lots. Au titre du lot 1, il sera demandé au titulaire d’assurer la fourniture des « cœurs systèmes » de décontamination des petits détachements (SDPD) et leurs servitudes (tuyaux, raccords etc.), la formation des personnels sur les systèmes, la maîtrise technique ainsi que le maintien en condition opérationnelle des équipements réparables. Par ailleurs, il est demandé au titre de ce lot, d’assurer des prestations de mises en kit des éléments de décontamination des cœurs systèmes. Ces éléments devront être conditionnés dans des caisses aérotransportables. Au titre du lot 2, il sera demandé au titulaire d’assurer la fourniture des petits matériels et consommables de décontamination, de désinfection et de protection. Par ailleurs, il est demandé au titre de ce lot, d’assurer des prestations de mises en kit des matériels et consommables concernés. ----- Il est précisé que la date et l'heure limites pour la remise des plis est 10/12/2026 à 11H00 (heure de Paris). Celles inscrites à la rubrique 5.1.12 sont au format UTC ----- Le marché est alloti en 2 lots. ----- ­­­­­ La quantité/volumétrie estimée pour le projet d’accord­-cadre est au titre du lot 1, de 35 systèmes de décontamination pour petits détachements en ferme, et l’accord-­­cadre prévoira la possibilité d’en acheter 75 de plus, sans engagement de la part de l’État. Le lot 2 a un montant estimé à 40 millions d’euros toutes taxes comprises, sans engagement de la part de l’État. Le montant estimé inscrit à la rubrique 2.1.3 correspond à une estimation globale pour le projet d’accord-cadre, sans engagement de la part de l’État. ----- En complément de la rubrique 5.1.15 : Il s’agit d’un accord­cadre composite (partie ferme avec une partie à bons de commande, une part provisionnelle et des tranches optionnelles). Le présent accord­cadre comprend à la fois des prestations forfaitaires, des prestations optionnelles en application des articles R1113-4 à R1113-6 du Code la Commande Publique et d’autres prestations susceptibles d’être commandées par bons de commande en application de l’article R2362­8 du Code de la Commande Publique (CCP) Prestations sur provision : en application des articles R2372­19 à R2372­21 du Code de la Commande Publique. Le marché pouvant présenter des aléas techniques importants, il comportera une part provisionnelle destinée à l’achat de fournitures et de services nécessaires à l’exécution du marché et qui n’auraient pas pu être définis avec précision dans le marché initial. La structure du marché (postes, etc…) peut évoluer si nécessaire en cours de négociation ----- Il s’agit d’un accord-cadre mono attributaire par lot. ----- Les candidats doivent préciser s’ils se présentent seuls ou en groupement. title: Finland – Refurbishment work – JYK 3 peruskorjaus projektinjohtourakka
description: Järvenpään kaupunki (jäljempänä ”Tilaaja”) pyytää tarjoustanne Järvenpään yhteiskoulun 3. vaiheen (JYK 3) peruskorjaushankkeen projektinjohtourakasta (PJU) tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohteena on osoitteessa Kansakoulunkatu 1, 04400 Järvenpää sijaitsevan koulurakennuksen peruskorjaus. Vuonna 1952 valmistunut koulurakennus on asemakaavassa suojeltu merkinnällä sr-11. Peruskorjauksen laajuus on noin 4 063 brm². Hanke käsittää koulurakennuksen laajan peruskorjauksen, taloteknisen perusparannuksen, tilamuutokset sekä rakennukseen liittyvät piha- ja aluerakennustyöt. Peruskorjaus käsittää muun muassa: - rakennuksen sisäpuoliset purku-, korjaus- ja muutostyöt - rakennuksen rakenteiden, julkisivujen, ikkunoiden, ovien ja vesikaton korjaustyöt suunnitelmien mukaisessa laajuudessa - taloteknisten järjestelmien (LVIA ja sähkö) uudistamisen - tilojen pintarakenteiden, kiintokalusteiden ja varusteiden uusimisen sekä muutostyöt - piha-alueiden, kulkuyhteyksien ja aluerakenteiden muutostyöt. Urakka sisältää kaikki tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen mukaiset rakennus-, purku-, maa- ja talotekniset työt tarvittavine oheistöineen siten, että rakennuskohde saatetaan täysin valmiiksi ja käyttötarkoitustaan vastaavaan kuntoon. Rakennuskohde sijaitsee koulutontilla, jolla on myös muita käytössä olevia koulurakennuksia. Niissä koulun toiminta jatkuu rakennustöiden aikana. Urakoitsijan tulee huomioida toiminnan jatkuminen erityisesti työmaajärjestelyissä, kulkuyhteyksissä, työmaan turvallisuudessa ja työstä aiheutuvien haittojen hallinnassa. Hankinta toteutetaan projektinjohtourakkana, joka muodostuu kehitysvaiheesta ja sen jälkeen tilaajan erillisellä päätöksellä käynnistettävästä toteutusvaiheesta. Kehitysvaiheessa valittu projektinjohtourakoitsija osallistuu yhteistyössä tilaajan ja suunnittelijoiden kanssa hankkeen suunnitelmien, toteutusratkaisujen, hankintojen, aikataulun ja kustannusten tarkentamiseen sekä toteutusvaiheen valmisteluun. Toteutusvaiheessa projektinjohtourakoitsija toimii kohteen pääurakoitsijana ja lainsäädännön tarkoittamana päätoteuttajana sekä vastaa työmaan johtovelvollisuuksista, työmaapalveluista ja hankintojen toteuttamisesta tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa määritellyssä laajuudessa. Toteutusvaiheen käynnistäminen edellyttää tilaajan erillistä päätöstä. Hankinnan kaupallinen malli, kehitys- ja toteutusvaiheen tehtävät sekä sopimusmenettely on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteissä. Projektinjohtourakan kehitysvaihe käynnistyy alustavasti helmikuussa 2027 hankintapäätöksen tekemisen, hankintalain mukaisen odotusajan ja kehitysvaiheen sopimuksen allekirjoittamisen jälkeen. Rakentamisvaiheen on tarkoitus käynnistyä maalis–huhtikuussa 2027. Tarkempi rakentamisen aloitusajankohta ja toteutusaikataulu sovitaan kehitysvaiheen aikana yhteistyössä tilaajan kanssa. Urakan tulee olla kokonaisuudessaan valmis ja tilaajan hyväksytysti vastaanottama viimeistään 1.12.2028. Kaikki rakennuksen käyttöönottoon, turvallisuuteen ja toiminnan aloittamiseen olennaisesti vaikuttavat virheet ja puutteet tulee olla korjattuina tähän määräaikaan mennessä. Mahdollisten vähäisten, käyttöönottoa estämättömien virheiden ja puutteiden korjaamisesta sovitaan erikseen tilaajan kanssa. Urakan hyväksytyn vastaanoton edellytyksenä on lisäksi rakennusvalvontaviranomaisen hyväksyntä rakennuksen käyttöönotolle osittaisessa loppukatselmuksessa (käyttöönottokatselmuksessa) tai loppukatselmuksessa siltä osin kuin hyväksynnän saaminen riippuu PJU:n vastuulla olevista suorituksista ja velvoitteista. PJU:n vastuualueen ulkopuolisesta syystä johtuva viranomaishyväksynnän viivästyminen ei yksin estä PJU:n urakkasuorituksen sopimusoikeudellista vastaanottoa, mikäli muut vastaanoton edellytykset täyttyvät. Tarkemmat ehdot on määritelty urakkaohjelmassa ja toteutusvaiheen sopimusluonnoksessa. Rakennuksen käyttäjien muutto ja toiminnan käynnistämiseen liittyvät järjestelyt ajoittuvat alustavasti joulukuulle 2028. Toiminta rakennuksessa on tarkoitus aloittaa tammikuussa 2029. Tarjoajille järjestetään mahdollisuus tutustua rakennuskohteeseen ja siellä vallitseviin olosuhteisiin kahtena ennalta ilmoitettuna ajankohtana: - torstaina 12.11.2026 klo 9-10.30 - keskiviikkona 18.11.2026 klo 9-10.30 Kohdetutustumisiin voi osallistua saapumalla paikalle edellä ilmoitettuina ajankohtina. Erillistä ilmoittautumista ei edellytetä. Kohteeseen tutustuminen on suositeltavaa, mutta ei tarjouksen jättämisen edellytys. Tarjoaja vastaa siitä, että se on perehtynyt hankkeen lähtötietoihin ja huomioinut tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa esitetyt olosuhteet ja vaatimukset tarjouksessaan. Tarjouspyyntöä koskevat kysymykset tulee esittää Tarjouspalvelun kautta tarjouspyynnössä ilmoitettuun määräaikaan mennessä. Kohdetutustumisten yhteydessä ei anneta tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoja täydentäviä tai muuttavia tietoja, vaan kaikki tällaiset tarkennukset toimitetaan tarjoajille Tarjouspalvelun kautta. Tarjoajan edellytetään tulkitsevan tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoja rakennusalan ammattilaisena ja asiantuntijana. Mikäli tarjoaja havaitsee asiakirjoissa puutteita tai epäselvyyksiä, jotka voivat vaikuttaa tarjouksen sisältöön, tulee niistä tiedustella tarjouspyynnössä esitetyllä tavalla ennen tarjouksen jättämistä. Urakan tarkempi sisältö, toteutusmalli, kaupalliset ehdot sekä sopimusasiakirjojen keskinäinen pätevyysjärjestys on määritelty tarjouspyynnön liitteissä.

Potilaskohtaisessa arvioinnissa huomioidaan muun muassa laitteen ohjelmointiominaisuudet, potilasohjaimen käytettävyys sekä virtalähteen tyyppi (ladattava tai ei-ladattava). title: Rammeavtale for renholdsmaskiner
description: Bakgrunn Telemark fylkeskommune ønsker å etablere en helhetlig og fremtidsrettet rammeavtale for renholdsmaskiner til videregående skoler, tannklinikker og øvrige fylkeskommunale bygg. Dagens maskinpark består av ulike maskintyper og fabrikater, og anskaffelser har i stor grad vært gjennomført som enkeltkjøp. En felles rammeavtale skal bidra til mer effektive anskaffelser, forutsigbare betingelser, enklere kontraktsoppfølging og bedre tilgang til service, reservedeler og teknisk support. Rammeavtalen skal dekke både tradisjonelle og autonome renholdsmaskiner. Fylkeskommunen ønsker å legge til rette for effektiv ressursbruk, økt automatisering og hensiktsmessig standardisering, samtidig som ulike lokasjoner kan velge løsninger tilpasset sine behov. Ved valg av løsninger skal det legges vekt på funksjonalitet, driftssikkerhet, klima- og miljøhensyn og samlede kostnader gjennom levetiden. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder etablering av en rammeavtale for levering av tradisjonelle og autonome renholdsmaskiner med tilhørende utstyr og tjenester til Telemark fylkeskommune. Rammeavtalen skal blant annet omfatte: Gulvvaskemaskiner og kombimaskiner, herunder kompakte og fleksible løsninger for mindre arealer. Batteridrevne støvsugere og øvrige relevante støvsugere. Tepperensere, dampmaskiner og High Speed-maskiner for gulvvedlikehold. Autonome renholdsmaskiner og robotløsninger, inkludert løsninger for automatisering av eksisterende maskiner. Moppvaskemaskiner og moppekjøleskap. Tilbehør, børster, pads, slitedeler, reservedeler og maskintilpasset forbruksmateriell. Rammeavtalen omfatter kjøp av alle obligatoriske maskinkategorier og funksjonsleie som alternativ for de autonome kategoriene som er angitt i prisskjemaet. Ordinær leie omfattes ikke. Funksjonsleie innebærer at oppdragsgiver betaler et månedlig vederlag for avtalt funksjon fremfor å eie maskinen. Ordningen gjelder utvalgte autonome renholdsmaskiner og inkluderer nødvendig utstyr, programvare, opplæring, service, vedlikehold og driftsoppfølging. Nærmere innhold og vilkår fremgår av kravspesifikasjonen og avtaledokumentene. Leverandøren skal kunne levere nødvendig utstyr og tjenester for sikker og stabil drift gjennom avtaleperioden. Dette omfatter blant annet batterier, reservedeler, programvareoppdateringer, dokumentasjon, opplæring og teknisk bistand. For autonome løsninger skal det legges til rette for sikker navigasjon, hensiktsmessig digital styring og rapportering samt forsvarlig behandling av data og personopplysninger. Rammeavtalen inngås med én leverandør for en periode på to år, med opsjon på forlengelse i ytterligere ett år + ett år. Oppdragsgiver foretar avrop etter faktisk behov og tilgjengelige budsjettrammer. Oppgitte mengder er estimater og innebærer ingen kjøpsforpliktelse.

title: Rehabilitering av vei, vann og avløp fra Fjordvegen til Langodden 55 på Norefjord
description: Bakgrunn Nore og Uvdal kommune skal rehabilitere vei, vann- og avløpsanlegg på strekningen fra Fjordvegen til Langodden 33 på Norefjord. Anskaffelsen gjennomføres fordi eksisterende ledningsnett og vei er nedslitt, og dagens standard ikke i tilstrekkelig grad ivaretar driftssikkerhet, fremkommelighet og en langsiktig, kostnadseffektiv forvaltning. Formålet er å etablere en robust og varig infrastruktur for vei, vann, avløp og overvann på den aktuelle strekningen. Kommunen ønsker å redusere risikoen for driftsforstyrrelser, bedre adkomsten for beboere og utrykningskjøretøy og legge til rette for enklere vedlikehold i årene fremover. For leverandører er det viktig å være kjent med at prosjektet skal gjennomføres i et område der trafikkavvikling, adkomst for berørte eiendommer og koordinering med kommunal VA-drift vil være sentrale forhold. Gjennomføringen må derfor planlegges slik at nødvendige tjenester opprettholdes og ulempene for omgivelsene begrenses i anleggsperioden. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder en utførelsesentreprise for rehabilitering av vei, vann- og avløpsanlegg på strekningen fra Fjordvegen til Langodden 55 på Norefjord. Oppdraget omfatter i hovedsak etablering eller utskifting av vann- og avløpsledninger med tilhørende kummer og nødvendige løsninger for overvannshåndtering. Videre omfatter oppdraget oppbygging og rehabilitering av vei med nytt dekke, samt tilhørende arbeider som er nødvendige for å ferdigstille en helhetlig og funksjonell løsning innenfor prosjektområdet. Leveransen skal også omfatte nødvendige tiltak for sikker og forsvarlig gjennomføring i anleggsperioden, herunder håndtering av trafikk og adkomst, samt koordinert utførelse som ivaretar berørte innbyggere og eksisterende infrastruktur. Det forventes en komplett leveranse i samsvar med konkurransegrunnlaget, med vekt på kvalitet, fremdrift og en løsning som gir varig funksjon og driftssikkerhet.

title: Germany – Research and development services and related consultancy services – [AI-as-OS] Artificial Intelligence as Operating System
description: Artificial intelligence (AI) methods have been expanding into new areas of application for years. AI systems are increasingly capable of handling complex tasks with greater autonomy—for example, through agent-based approaches that run an AI agent on a computer to perform any task automatically or even autonomously, sometimes without explicit human instructions but rather based on identified intentions (see, for example, the open-source software OpenClaw, which can handle tasks such as calendar maintenance or file management). Just how deeply AI algorithms and models are now integrated into everyday applications is also evident in the fact that end devices are increasingly operable entirely without visible applications and exclusively via voice control, which fundamentally rethinks the way we interact with them (such as Deutsche Telekom’s AI Phone). The central control units of such end devices—the operating systems themselves—are also increasingly being enhanced with new AI functionalities to continuously improve system efficiency. These include initial theoretical—and in some cases already practical—approaches to using the latest AI technologies for file system or storage management. These developments mark a fundamental paradigm shift: AI is no longer viewed merely as an add-on, but increasingly as a native architectural component of the operating system itself. The AI-as-OS program aims to explore how artificial intelligence can be understood not merely as a separately encapsulated functionality that is simply executed by the operating system, but as the operating system itself—Artificial Intelligence as Operating System. Behind this lies the vision of an AI that not only supports individual applications but also acts as the central control system for the entire computer ecosystem, managing system resources (including the CPU, RAM, and system security) in a data-driven, adaptive, and context-aware manner. The aim of the program is to make fundamental contributions to the development of AI-based operating systems as the control unit of a computer system. Through the extensive integration of AI technologies into deep operating system layers, such a system is intended to manage system resources, enable context-aware operational decisions, and enhance system security through adaptive threat detection and defense. Since the underlying technology is still largely in a speculative stage, the scope of development work ranges from the general architecture of such an operating system to the integration of AI-based core mechanisms, and includes new considerations regarding the security and stability requirements for such an operating system, depending on the target platform (e.g., desktop, data center, edge device) and the application environment. The program’s main areas of research include: • AI-Centric Operating System Architectures: Concepts for the fundamental design of an operating system in which AI is viewed not as an add-on feature but as an integral part of the architecture. • AI-Native Core Mechanisms: Integration of AI-based methods into core operating system functions such as resource management, process control, and memory organization. • Control, Security, and Stability: Requirements for traceability, controllability, and robustness of an AI-based operating system, as well as approaches to adaptive threat detection and defense. From today’s perspective, it remains to be seen whether—and to what extent—the vision of an AI-native operating system can be technically realized. This is precisely where the program’s value lies: AI-as-OS explores a largely speculative field at the intersection of AI research and system software, the results of which could set the course for the operating systems of tomorrow.

title: France – Engineering services – Maitrise d'oeuvre relative à la rénovation énergétique du garage atelier métro ligne A de Chantepie
description: Le contrat comporte des tranches optionnelles définies au cahier des charges. Le détail des missions confiées au titulaire figure au programme prévisionnel. Les prestations sont réglées par des prix forfaitaires. Le garage atelier du métro de Chantepie, situé route de Vern, héberge à la fois des activités industrielles (exploitation des lignes A et B de métro via le Poste de Commande Centralisé et maintenance des rames ligne A) et tertiaires (services transverses de Keolis Rennes Métropole). Il a été mis en service en 2002 lors du lancement de la ligne A et a fait l'objet d'une extension en 2011 à l'occasion du projet d'augmentation de capacité de cette même ligne. Aucun programme de rénovation énergétique d'envergure n'a été mené depuis la mise en service du site au début des années 2000 : il est donc exploité avec les technologies et performances de l'époque. Dans une optique de réduction et de maitrise des dépenses liés à la consommation énergétique, des audits ont été menés en 2023-2024 sur ce site par la société ALTEREA. Ces audits ont permis de dresser une liste des solutions d'amélioration efficaces et rentables à courts, moyens et longs termes (investissements, gains énergétiques, confort, etc.). Chacune de ces modifications était justifiée en chiffrant l'investissement nécessaire et en présentant les gains énergétiques espérés. L'opération consiste en une réhabilitation de bâtiment au sens de la loi MOP. Elle nécessitera de mener les études puis effectuer les travaux de rénovation du bâtiment principal (atelier) du site dénommé &quot;garage atelier Chantepie&quot; (GATC) de la ligne A en vue d'améliorer sa performance énergétique. Les différentes compétences mobilisées sur cette opération sont les suivantes : - Études MOE dans le cadre de la loi MOP (AVP/PRO/ACT/VISA/EXE/DET/AOR/OPC) - Renforcement des structures de l'atelier, - Modernisation du système de chauffage, - Isolation, - Modernisation de la ventilation, - Installation de panneaux photovoltaïque pour de l'autoconsommation Ces compétences ne présument en rien l'allotissement pressenti des travaux qui sera déterminé en phase AVP

title: Sight Testing and Dispensing of Spectacles to Children and Young People in Special Educational Settings (SES) - South West
description: This notice is inform the market of an opportunity to deliver Sight Testing and Dispensing of Spectacles to Children and Young People in Special Educational Settings within the South West region, covering Devon, Cornwall and Isles of Scilly (CIOS), Bristol, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire (BNSSG) and Gloucestershire Integrated Care Boards (ICBs). BNSSG, Gloucestershire, Devon and CIOS ICBs ('the Commissioner') are the contracting authorities for this procurement. The Commissioner may be subject to a restructure of its functions during or following this procurement process. In such circumstances, the functions to which this contract relates may be transferred to a successor or replacement public body. Bidders will be informed of any such change, and any changes because of it. The procurement is divided into the following Lots: • Lot 1: BNSSG and Gloucestershire • Lot 2: Devon and CIOS The contract(s) term will be for 3 years and 5 months (inclusive of the mobilisation period) plus a possible extension of up to a period of a further 2 years. Both contract(s) are due to commence on 01 April 2027 with service delivery anticipated to commence from 01 September 2027. The annual contract value for Lot 1 is £306,000 with a total maximum contract value of £1,530,000 (including extension option). The annual contract value for Lot 2 is £350,000 with a total maximum contract value of £1,750,000 (including extension option). Interested parties who wish to take part in the procurement are invited to take part in an Invitation to Tender (ITT) process, based on the competitive 'open' procedure. All ITT responses must be returned by 12 noon on 10th December 2026. Interested providers will be able to view the opportunity and access the tender documentation via the 'Live Opportunities' list on the e-procurement system, Atamis, available on the following link: https://health-family.force.com/s/Welcome This exercise is being carried out by NHS South, Central and West Commissioning Support Unit (SCW) on behalf of the Commissioner. SCW is currently subject to restructuring, and the management of this procurement may therefore move to a successor at some point during the procurement process. Bidders will be informed of any such change, and any administrative changes because of it.

title: Enabling Technology for Future Missions
description: SPACE TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM BACKGROUND The Space Technology Development Program (STDP) mandate is to formulate, implement and manage contracted out research and development (R&D) projects in response to identified needs. Its objectives are to develop and demonstrate strategic technologies that have a strong potential for reducing technical uncertainties for future Canadian space activities. The STDP will therefore support the development of technologies to meet the current and future needs of the Canadian Space Program. OBJECTIVES The objective of this Statement of Work (SOW) is to enable the development of Space Technologies that are in line with the Canadian Space Agency’s (CSA) priorities and mission roadmaps. For the Priority Technology (PT) specified herein (see APPENDIX A-5 of ANNEX A), the work solicited is the development and advancement of the technology (Technology Readiness Levels (TRL)), (see APPENDIX A-1 of ANNEX A) to reduce technical uncertainties and support approval and implementation of specific potential future space missions of interest to Canada.

title: Tierpark Bern Dählhölzli, Neu- und Ersatzbauten, 291 Architekturleistungen, Studienauftrag mit 2 Lose
description:
La Ville de Berne gère plusieurs installations zoologiques sous le nom de « Tierpark Bern » (Parc zoologique de Berne). Elle offre à la population des possibilités de détente et des expériences personnelles, transmet et développe des connaissances sur la faune et la flore, et sensibilise le public à la détention des animaux dans le respect de leurs besoins, ainsi qu’à la protection de la nature et des espèces. Le Tierpark Bern comprend notamment les sites du Dählhölzli et du Parc aux ours (Bären Park). Afin de répondre aux besoins d’un nombre croissant de visiteurs et d’assurer une détention des animaux adaptée à leurs besoins, des investissements sont prévus dans les infrastructures et les enclos existants ainsi que dans de nouvelles installations. Par ailleurs, des mesures sont envisagées pour améliorer les conditions de travail du personnel. Parallèlement, le Tierpark Bern entend accorder une attention accrue, à l’avenir, aux défis posés par le changement climatique et la perte de biodiversité. Le périmètre du projet abrite en outre des habitats et des espèces protégés par la Loi fédérale sur la protection de la nature et du paysage (LPN) ; leur préservation, ou une compensation équivalente, doit impérativement être prise en compte lors du développement du projet.


La réalisation de ces objectifs implique des transformations spatiales. Il s’agit de créer de nouvelles installations et de remplacer celles qui sont vétustes. De plus, l’accès au site du Dählhölzli doit être amélioré pour les personnes en situation de handicap. Cette démarche constitue un élément essentiel de la planification globale du Tierpark Bern pour la période 2023–2033, laquelle décrit en détail la vision et la stratégie de ce qui se veut être « le parc zoologique le plus charmant de Suisse ».

description: Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN) Commercial Solution Opening (CSO) Call for Solutions (CfS) for Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) Project Office/Customer Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Contracting Activity Army Contracting Command � Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG) CSO Number Army Open Solicitation (AOS) - W9128Z-25-S-A002 Call for Solution Title Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) Contracting Points of Contact Contracting Officer: Licinda Peters Email: licinda.m.peters.civ@army.mil Contract Specialist: Keith Magaw Email: keith.a.magaw.civ@army.mil Questions Due Date/Time 05 November 2026 at noon Eastern Standard Time (EST) Solution Brief Due Date/Time 10 December 2026 at noon Eastern Standard Time (EST) Submit Solution Brief Via Sam.gov and AOS Controlled by U.S. Army Controlled by: PdM WESS CUI Category: Operations Security (OPSEC) Limited Dissemination Control: FEDCON POC: licinda.m.peters.civ@army.mil SECTION 1 - INTRODUCTION BACKGROUND Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) is seeking solutions for a Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Digital Intermediate Frequency (IF) system to satisfy the requirements for Increment 1 of this modernization effort. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 � REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solutions for Next-Generation SATCOM Teleports Background & Operational Context Current Department of War (DoW) satellite communications (SATCOM) ground infrastructure relies heavily on legacy L-Band Intermediate Frequency (IF) distribution systems. These analog-hardware-bound architectures limit flexibility, inhibit rapid tech insertion, and create single points of failure across global teleport infrastructures. To counter emerging near-peer threats in dynamic operational environments, the warfighter requires highly resilient, agile, and rapidly scalable SATCOM. The Problem The legacy L-Band architecture fails to offer the ability to dynamically route or transport Radio Frequency (RF) signals over DoW Internet Protocol (IP) networks. This lack of flexibility inhibits the resilience of geostationary earth orbit (GEO) SATCOM operations. To transition to a modern, flexible, software-defined ground segment, the DoW requires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. SCOPE AND TECHNICAL OBJECTIVES The scope of this effort is to acquire, integrate, test, and field a commercially available or commercial-derivative Digital IF suite, and to operationalize it within existing DoW Teleports. The subsystem shall demonstrate the core capability to digitize analog L-band satellite signals, transport them over a high-speed digital network, and convert them back to analog signals, while handling native digital IF traffic from modems. The subsystem shall leverage mature commercial solutions with an emphasis on automation, reliability, and adherence to open standards, for example, the IEEE-ISTO Std 4900-2021 (DIFI) standard. The offeror shall propose a commercial solution that achieves the following high-level technical objectives, aligned with the core characteristics of the DoW modernization framework: Objective 1: Interoperable Digital IF Conversion (Modular & Open): The DIFS shall convert legacy analog L-band aggregate signals (950 MHz - 2.050 GHz) into standards-compliant Digital IF packet streams and vice versa. This includes both transmit (analog-to-digital) and receive (digital-to-analog) paths, conforming to the DIFI standard to prevent vendor lock-in. Objective 2: Advanced Digital Signal Processing (Adaptable): The commercial subsystem shall combine multiple, disparate Digital IF streams into a single aggregate (combined) stream for uplink and channelize a single aggregate (combined) downlink stream into multiple, individual Digital IF streams for processing. Objective 3: High-Performance Digital Transport (Scalable): The subsystem shall utilize a non-blocking, high-speed digital switch fabric to route Digital IF streams between all subsystem components and external interfaces (e.g., Digital Modems, Global Agile Integrated Transport (GAIT) connections, Wide Area Network (WAN) transport etc. The fabric shall support standard network scaling, redundancy, and high-throughput operations (up to 100 Gigabit Ethernet). The switch fabric shall provide a means for rapid reconfiguration of packet forwarding by the Automated Management and Control Function without the use of Layer 3 routing protocols. The switch fabric shall use deterministic multicast routing based on the incoming port without requiring strict multicast tables. Objective 4: Automated Management and Control (Empowered): The subsystem shall feature a software-based management suite. This software shall automate the establishment, termination, and monitoring of communication paths based on satellite access parameters, manage automatic protection switching for redundant components, and support automated rerouting of critical traffic to alternate facilities. Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN) Commercial Solution Opening (CSO) Call for Solutions (CfS) for Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) Project Office/Customer Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Contracting Activity Army Contracting Command � Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG) CSO Number Army Open Solicitation (AOS) - W9128Z-25-S-A002 Call for Solution Title Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) Contracting Points of Contact Contracting Officer: Licinda Peters Email: licinda.m.peters.civ@army.mil Contract Specialist: Keith Magaw Email: keith.a.magaw.civ@army.mil Questions Due Date/Time 05 November 2026 at noon Eastern Standard Time (EST) Solution Brief Due Date/Time 10 December 2026 at noon Eastern Standard Time (EST) Submit Solution Brief Via Sam.gov and AOS Controlled by U.S. Army Controlled by: PdM WESS CUI Category: Operations Security (OPSEC) Limited Dissemination Control: FEDCON POC: licinda.m.peters.civ@army.mil SECTION 1 - INTRODUCTION BACKGROUND Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) is seeking solutions for a Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Digital Intermediate Frequency (IF) system to satisfy the requirements for Increment 1 of this modernization effort. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 � REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solutions for Next-Generation SATCOM Teleports Background & Operational Context Current Department of War (DoW) satellite communications (SATCOM) ground infrastructure relies heavily on legacy L-Band Intermediate Frequency (IF) distribution systems. These analog-hardware-bound architectures limit flexibility, inhibit rapid tech insertion, and create single points of failure across global teleport infrastructures. To counter emerging near-peer threats in dynamic operational environments, the warfighter requires highly resilient, agile, and rapidly scalable SATCOM. The Problem The legacy L-Band architecture fails to offer the ability to dynamically route or transport Radio Frequency (RF) signals over DoW Internet Protocol (IP) networks. This lack of flexibility inhibits the resilience of geostationary earth orbit (GEO) SATCOM operations. To transition to a modern, flexible, software-defined ground segment, the DoW requires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. SCOPE AND TECHNICAL OBJECTIVES The scope of this effort is to acquire, integrate, test, and field a commercially available or commercial-derivative Digital IF suite, and to operationalize it within existing DoW Teleports. The subsystem shall demonstrate the core capability to digitize analog L-band satellite signals, transport them over a high-speed digital network, and convert them back to analog signals, while handling native digital IF traffic from modems. The subsystem shall leverage mature commercial solutions with an emphasis on automation, reliability, and adherence to open standards, for example, the IEEE-ISTO Std 4900-2021 (DIFI) standard. The offeror shall propose a commercial solution that achieves the following high-level technical objectives, aligned with the core characteristics of the DoW modernization framework: Objective 1: Interoperable Digital IF Conversion (Modular & Open): The DIFS shall convert legacy analog L-band aggregate signals (950 MHz - 2.050 GHz) into standards-compliant Digital IF packet streams and vice versa. This includes both transmit (analog-to-digital) and receive (digital-to-analog) paths, conforming to the DIFI standard to prevent vendor lock-in. Objective 2: Advanced Digital Signal Processing (Adaptable): The commercial subsystem shall combine multiple, disparate Digital IF streams into a single aggregate (combined) stream for uplink and channelize a single aggregate (combined) downlink stream into multiple, individual Digital IF streams for processing. Objective 3: High-Performance Digital Transport (Scalable): The subsystem shall utilize a non-blocking, high-speed digital switch fabric to route Digital IF streams between all subsystem components and external interfaces (e.g., Digital Modems, Global Agile Integrated Transport (GAIT) connections, Wide Area Network (WAN) transport etc. The fabric shall support standard network scaling, redundancy, and high-throughput operations (up to 100 Gigabit Ethernet). The switch fabric shall provide a means for rapid reconfiguration of packet forwarding by the Automated Management and Control Function without the use of Layer 3 routing protocols. The switch fabric shall use deterministic multicast routing based on the incoming port without requiring strict multicast tables. Objective 4: Automated Management and Control (Empowered): The subsystem shall feature a software-based management suite. This software shall automate the establishment, termination, and monitoring of communication paths based on satellite access parameters, manage automatic protection switching for redundant components, and support automated rerouting of critical traffic to alternate facilities. description: ****SOURCES SOUGHT FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY**** This announcement seeks information from industry which will be used for preliminary planning purposes. No proposals are being requested or accepted with this announcement. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT SHALL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SYNOPSIS. NO SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATIONS OR DRAWINGS ARE AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. 1. AGENCY: United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA) 2. NAICS: 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction 3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE: Peru 4. ACQUISITION INFORMATION: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA), is issuing this Sources Sought announcement as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support a potential future design-build construction project at the Callao Naval Base, Lima, Peru. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. Estimated Magnitude of Construction: Between $25,000,000 and $50,000,000. Performance Period: 540 days after Notice to Proceed. Anticipated Award Date: Fiscal Year 2027 Quarter 3 Small Business Programs: In accordance with FAR 19.000(b)(1)(ii), the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO) has elected not to apply FAR Part 19 (Small Business Programs) to this overseas procurement. Consequently, small business set-asides will not be utilized for this project in Peru. However, all responsible sources�including both U.S. concerns (large and small) and foreign entities�are encouraged to submit responses to this Sources Sought notice. 5. ANTICIPATED ACQUISITION STRATEGY: The acquisition strategy for this requirement will be determined based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice and other market research. The Government is considering several compliant acquisition pathways to ensure the successful delivery of this complex Design-Build project in Peru. All interested firms are strongly encouraged to submit a comprehensive capabilities statement, as the information received will be critical in determining the final method of procurement. The primary anticipated strategy is a Two-Phase Design-Build procurement under the authority of FAR Part 36.3. In this scenario, the Government would issue a public Phase 1 solicitation requesting offeror qualifications. Based on these qualifications, the Government would down-select the most highly qualified firms (typically no more than five) who would then be eligible to compete in Phase 2 and submit detailed technical and price proposals. However, based on the unique challenges of performing complex construction in Peru, the Government is also considering the following alternative strategies: Option 1: Limited Competition under FAR Part 6, Other Than Full and Open Competition. If market research reveals that only a very limited number of sources possess the unique combination of Design-Build expertise, mandatory Peruvian licensing (Registro Nacional de Proveedores - RNP), and demonstrated experience with specialized facilities (e.g., POL, medical, secure warehouses) in the local market, the Government may justify limiting competition. Option 2: Establishment of a Qualified Bidders List (QBL) under FAR Part 9.2. If the operational environment in Peru and the specialized nature of the requirement warrant it, the Government may decide to establish a formal Qualification Requirement. Under this authority, the Government would create a list of pre-qualified firms that demonstrate the essential standards for technical capability, financial stability, and in-country operational capacity. Future solicitations for this requirement would then be limited to firms on this established QBL. The Government�s final decision will be based on which strategy provides the best value and ensures a competitive environment among responsible and qualified contractors capable of meeting the demanding technical and logistical requirements of this project. 6. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The contemplated scope consists of complete Design-Build services�including geotechnical verification, site preparation, civil works, architectural and engineering design after award, structural construction, mechanical/electrical/plumbing (MEP), specialized HVAC/fire suppression, Defense Base Act (DBA) insurance coverage, and Furniture, Fixtures, & Equipment (FF&E). Facility / Scope Package Primary Function Key Technical Considerations Building 110 Spare Parts Warehouse Heavy-duty slab design, industrial racking integration, material handling flow, automated logistics staging. Building 115 Clothing & Gear Warehouse High-density pallet storage, humidity and climate control, inventory distribution bays. Building 112 Material Warehouse Bulk staging, overhead crane/hoist accommodations, heavy equipment ingress/egress ramps. Building 113 Customs Warehouse Secure bonded holding areas, host-nation customs inspection layout, physical security infrastructure. Building 114 Petroleum, Oil, and Lubricants (POL) Warehouse Secondary containment, explosion-proof electrical systems, specialized foam/water fire suppression, environmental drainage controls. Building 111 Medicine & Medical Supplies Warehouse Temperature/humidity-controlled storage (cold chain capability), pharmaceutical-grade clean finishings, backup power integration. Building 120 DIRNOTEMAT & Quality Control Building Administrative offices, testing and quality inspection laboratories, specialized testing benches, IT/telecom infrastructure. Site & Ancillary Works Infrastructure & Integration Site grading, structural fill, perimeter security, access roads, utility connections, complete FF&E packages, and host-nation compliant permitting. 7. SOURCES SOUGHT: The purpose of this source sought is to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities and qualifications of contractors who have the capabilities to complete and perform contracts of this magnitude, and to address any questions, recommendations or concerns from Industry. The Government must ensure there is adequate competition among potential pool of responsible contractors. Prior Government contract work is not required for submitting a response under this Sources Sought announcement. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. 8. RESPONSES: The Capabilities Statement for this Sources Sought is not intended to be a Request for Proposal nor Invitation for Bid, nor does it restrict the Government to an ultimate acquisition approach. It is to request statements regarding the company's ability to demonstrate existing-or-developed expertise and experience in relation to the areas specified herein. Any commercial brochures or currently existing marketing material may also be submitted. This synopsis is for information and planning purposes only and is neither to be construed as a commitment by the Government nor will the Government pay for information solicited. Respondents will not be notified of the results of the evaluation. Interested parties are requested to provide a capabilities statement addressing the following areas. title: Simulator Common Architecture Requirements and Standards (SCARS)
description: The Sources Sought results will assist the Air Force in determining whether this solicitation will be unrestricted competition or a small business set-aside for C-Type contract to fulfill Simulator Common Architecture Requirements and Standards (SCARS) requirements. The Government is assessing the capability of companies that may possess the expertise to competently and competitively respond to the following requirements for the SCARS program: For the SCARS Program, the contractor shall possess the capabilities to fulfill 1) Security Operations Center (SOC) Operations, 2) Remote Assessment & Authorization, 3) Software Patching Baseline Integrity, 4) Maintain a SCARS Library, 5) Edge Virtualization & Modern Deployment on SCARS On-Premise Equipment (OPE), 6) Network Integration & Management, 7) Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), 8) Governance of Architecture Standards, 9) Enterprise Logistics & Fielding, 10) Data Requirements and 11) Security Requirements. The contract will commence CY2030 with an anticipated transition period up to six (6) months leading to full operational performance in CY 2031. The anticipated structure includes a 4-year base period with six 1-year option periods and an optional 6-month extension of services (RFO 52.217-8 Option to Extend Services). All projected dates and contact structures are notional and subject to change based on market research and acquisition strategy approval. The Government anticipates the use of: Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Contract Line-item Numbers (CLINs): Services Cost Reimbursable CLINs: Travel and studies/analysis tasks Other: CLIN may be of any type authorized Further questions may be e-mailed to Contracting Officer, Steve Godby, steven.godby@us.af.mil, Contracting Officer, Anne Torian, anne.torian@us.af.mil, and Program Manager, Daniel Douglass, daniel.douglass.2@us.af.mil. Responses must be submitted via email to Contracting Officer, Anne Torian, anne.torian@us.af.mil and Program Manager, Daniel Douglass, daniel.douglass.2@us.af.mil and are due NLT 3:00 PM EST, 10 December 2026. title: Request for Information (RFI) for the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP)
description: FEMA is modernizing the National Flood Insurance Program to improve how it assesses and communicates flood risk, prices and delivers flood insurance, manages floodplains, and provides mitigation assistance. The goal is to help individuals, communities, states, and private-sector partners better understand and reduce flood risk while using policyholder and taxpayer funds efficiently. To support this effort, FEMA is integrating staff, initiatives, and support structures into a more unified NFIP operating model. The draft contract support model described in the RFI pursues those outcomes. Work will be grouped into several categories described in the RFI. Not all current NFIP support contracts will be recompeted immediately. This document also identifies selected support structures and contracts that are not currently within the scope of this RFI to provide a more complete picture of the NFIP support environment. Please see attached RFI for complete details.

title: Industry Day - USACE SPK Geotechnical Drilling and Laboratory Services
description: Special Notice: Virtual Industry Day Event Schedule & Platform Date of Event: December 10, 2026 (Thursday) Time: 1:00 PM � 2:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST) Location/Platform: Virtual via Microsoft Teams (see below for details) Purpose of Event The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Sacramento District (USACE-SPK) is pleased to announce a virtual Industry Day on December 10, 2026. The purpose of this session is to provide industry partners with a comprehensive overview of the upcoming Geotechnical Drilling Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC). The Government will present details regarding program requirements, anticipated geographic scope, proposed technical evaluation factors (such as specialized rig fleet inventory and AASHTO/USACE MTC laboratory accreditation standards), and the tentative acquisition milestone schedule. USACE-SPK anticipates issuing a formal solicitation under NAICS 541360in February 2027., and highly encourage participation from regional small businesses, prospective joint venture partners, and specialty subcontractors who intend to compete. Scope of Work and Technical Capabilities USACE-SPK seeks firms with the capabilities to provide comprehensive geotechnical drilling, cone penetrometer testing (CPT) services, and test-pit excavations utilizing backhoes and track hoes. The principal features of the work encompass soil drilling and sampling utilizing hollow-stem flight augers, solid-stem flight augers, mud-rotary, air-rotary, and percussion drilling methods, including ODEX, Down-hole Casing Advance Systems, or other specialized percussion drilling systems. Contract requirements will also mandate sonic drilling and sampling, alongside rock core drilling and sampling of up to 6-inch diameter using wireline or conventional diamond-impregnated drill bits. Soil sampling operations will require standard penetrometers and other split-barrel samplers up to 3-inch-diameter, as well as undisturbed soil sampling using Shelby push tubes and Pitcher barrels with Pitcher tubes. Field operations will further include CPT testing, piezometer and inclinometer installations, hydraulic pressure testing associated with rock core drilling, and observation well installation and development, which includes pump, permeability, and percolation testing. Contractors will be responsible for generating all associated documentation, to include detailed drill logs, trench or test-pit logs, as-built diagrams for all instrumentation and well installations, and percolation test records. Additionally, the contractor must occasionally furnish the professional services of a registered, licensed Geologist or Geotechnical Engineer. Furthermore, firms must possess the capability to provide certified geotechnical laboratory services. The required testing scope includes moisture content, soil classification, sieve analysis, hydrometer, Atterberg limits, consolidation, triaxial testing, direct shear, California Bearing Ratio (CBR), organic content, and Specific Gravity. To ensure data integrity, all laboratory testing must be performed by a facility accredited by the American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) in accordance with the corresponding ASTM standards. Finally, the laboratory must be, or successfully become, validated by the USACE Materials Testing Center (MTC) for all requested testing methods. title: Enhanced Mobile Satellite Services (EMSS) Equipment, Provisioning and Customer Care Help Desk Support
description: The United States Space Force (USSF) provides United States Government (USG) and other sponsored customers with satellite communication services through a dedicated, government-controlled gateway. The secure gateway communicates with the contracted commercial Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellation, and traffic processed through the secure gateway may be routed through secure government networks, public telephone networks, or other third-party networks. The program provides cradle-to-grave services and support to its customers, including baseline network airtime access, sale and provisioning of authorized devices, 24/7/365 dedicated help-desk support, enhanced Government capabilities such as encrypted communications, comprehensive operation and maintenance of the secure gateway, and other services. The objective of this possible follow-on effort is to deliver provisioning support and 24/7/365 dedicated help desk support to all authorized EMSS customers, including the Department of War (DoW), Federal Government, State and Local Government, approved foreign and allied governments, and other sponsored customers. The contractor may be required to provide EMSS Service Management services including Telecommunications Service Order (TSO) order management, warranty support, inventory management, supply chain functions, sub-contract management, provisioning activities, gateway liaison services, Return Material Authorization support, reporting, and program management. The scope includes provisioning, invoicing, record management, and customer care services for users who access the commercial satellite constellation through the secure gateway. Services include Telephony (Voice), Data Transmission (Circuit and Packet Switched), Short Burst Data messaging, Tactical Push-to-Talk voice and data, Paging and Alerting, Multicast Data Broadcasts, High-Speed Broadband services, Secure Voice, enhancements/evolutions of those services, and additional commercial services introduced during the period of performance and included under separately managed baseline access agreements. The Performance Work Statement (PES) contained in this posting is a secured attachment. To get access please submit a request through SAM.gov, including at a minimium POC name/contact information, vendor/entity name and CAGE code. Only vendors with Active SAM Registration will be considered for granted access and the Government reserves the right to deny access as it sees fit. These additional security measures are to comply with SF/SSC PA guidance.

description: g Die drei Krankenhäuser Aurich, Emden, Norden sollen zu einer Klinik zusammengeführt werden. title: Germany – Socks – Lieferung von Laufsocke
description: Unter dem Vorbehalt der Bereitstellung von Haushaltsmitteln in der erforderlichen Höhe besteht folgender Bedarf: 86.000 Paar Laufsocken gem. TL-B 214, Ausgabe 10/2026 Vertragszeitraum: bis 09.05.2029; 2 x 12 Monate Option. Am 01. Januar 2014 ist das Niedersächsische Gesetz zur Sicherung von Tariftreue und Wettbewerb bei der Vergabe von öffentlichen Aufträgen (Niedersächsisches Tariftreue- und Vergabegesetz - NTVergG) in Kraft getreten. Dieses Gesetz soll einen fairen Wettbewerb bei der Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge gewährleisten sowie die umwelt- und sozialveträgliche Beschaffung durch die öffentliche Hand fördern. Das NTVergG findet Anwendung auf alle öffentlichen Aufträge über Bau-, Dienst- und Lieferleistungen, einschließlich Dienstleistungen im Bereich des öffentlichen Personenverkehrs (ÖPNV) - ab einem geschätzten Auftragswert von 20.000,00 EUR (netto). Die Vergabe des Auftrags erfolgt gem. § 3 Absatz 1 NTVergG nach den Regelungen der Unterschwellenvergabeordnung (UVgO) vom 2. Februar 2017. Auf § 2 UVgO (Grundsätze der Vergabe) wird hingewiesen. Des Weiteren wird auf einige Grundsatzregelungen des Gesetzes gegen Wettbewerbsbeschränkungen (GWB), insbesondere § 97 Abs. 1 bis 6 GWB, verwiesen. Das Angebot ist elektronisch in Textform, über die Vergabeplattform, einzureichen. *NTVergG = Niedersächsisches Gesetz zur Sicherung von Tariftreue und Wettbewerb bei der Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge (Niedersächsisches Tariftreue- und Vergabegesetz) in der Fassung vom 20.01.2020.

description: To support European destinations in the smart and sustainable development of tourism, the EC is fostering the exchange of best practices that are inspiration for others. title: Netherlands – Gravel, sand, crushed stone and aggregates – Inkoop zand en grond BRM Harderweide fase 3

Deze Opdracht wordt in zijn geheel aanbesteed, er is geen sprake van perceelvorming. De Opdracht wordt gegund aan de inschrijver die de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving heeft gedaan op basis van de laagste prijs. title: Netherlands – Programming services of application software – Dataportaal Limburg module catalogus
description: Vanuit de ambitie om datagedreven te werken wil de Provincie Limburg de beschikbaarheid, vindbaarheid en het gebruik van data en informatieproducten optimaal faciliteren, zowel intern als extern. Het Dataportaal Limburg is daarbij de centrale plek waar data en informatieproducten toegankelijk en doorzoekbaar worden aangeboden, volgens het selfserviceprincipe. Het dataportaal is in 2020 gerealiseerd en bestaat uit de modules Catalogus en Basisvisualisaties, die technisch onafhankelijk van elkaar functioneren. De huidige omgeving is gebaseerd op het pakket Dataloket van Analyze by KBenP; zie https://dataportaal.prvlimburg.nl/. Sindsdien heeft de Provincie geïnvesteerd in de ontwikkeling van een modern datafundament. De huidige catalogusmodule sluit onvoldoende aan op dat datafundament, het toevoegen van nieuwe bronnen en connectoren kost relatief veel maatwerk, en de zoekervaring blijft achter bij wat gebruikers van moderne zoekmachines gewend zijn. Samen met de noodzaak de continuïteit van de dienstverlening vanaf 1 januari 2027 te borgen, vormt dat de aanleiding voor deze aanbesteding. De aanleiding, de context en de reikwijdte zijn nader beschreven in Opdrachtomschrijving. De opdracht omvat de levering, implementatie en het beheer van een bestaande, productiewaardige oplossing voor de module catalogus van het Dataportaal Limburg. Het betreft geen ontwikkeltraject: de oplossing kan waar nodig worden geconfigureerd of beperkt aangepast. Tot de opdracht behoren tevens de migratie vanuit de huidige catalogusomgeving, het realiseren van de koppelingen met de provinciale bronsystemen, en het verzorgen van training en handleidingen. De oplossing is de centrale vindplaats voor datasets, informatieproducten, dashboards, services en documenten uit diverse bronsystemen. Gebruikers vinden via één zoekingang zelfstandig wat zij nodig hebben en worden van daaruit doorgeleid naar het bronsysteem. De catalogus is daarmee een vindplaats en geen opslagplaats: metadata blijft zo dicht mogelijk bij de bron. De oplossing is bedoeld voor medewerkers van de Provincie, externe (keten)partners en burgers, waarbij openbare en vertrouwelijke informatie strikt worden gescheiden op basis van dataclassificatie. Het inhoudelijk beheer voert de Provincie zelf uit. De module Basisvisualisaties valt buiten de reikwijdte van deze aanbesteding.

title: Netherlands – Programming services of packaged software products – Statistische representatiesoftware
description: De Provincie Limburg wil medewerkers en externe gebruikers faciliteren in de vindbaarheid en laagdrempelige beschikbaarheid van data. Het Dataportaal Limburg vormt hiervoor de centrale voorziening waarin data vindbaar, toegankelijk en visueel beschikbaar wordt gesteld aan zowel de provinciale organisatie als daarbuiten. Uitgangspunt daarbij is het selfserviceprincipe: gebruikers kunnen zelfstandig relevante data opzoeken, visualiseren en exporteren. Daarnaast biedt het Dataportaal ruimte voor het publiceren en delen van dashboards en monitoringsinformatie ten behoeve van een breed publiek. Deze offerteaanvraag heeft specifiek betrekking op de statistische presentatiesoftware voor de basisvisualisatiemodule binnen het Dataportaal Limburg. Met deze module moeten openbare datasets op een intuïtieve en toegankelijke wijze kunnen worden geraadpleegd, gevisualiseerd, geëxporteerd en beheerd. De Provincie Limburg zoekt een bestaande SaaS-oplossing voor de basisvisualisatiemodule van het Dataportaal Limburg. Deze statistische presentatiesoftware moet gebruikers op een laagdrempelige en intuïtieve manier in staat stellen om zelfstandig data te raadplegen, te visualiseren en te exporteren, overeenkomstig het selfserviceprincipe. De oplossing dient basisvisualisaties te ondersteunen, waaronder tabellen, grafieken, kaarten en andere beschrijvende presentatievormen, en moet daarnaast mogelijkheden bieden voor het opstellen, publiceren en delen van dashboards en monitoringsproducten. Uitgangspunt hierbij is dat de data die in dashboards en monitoring wordt gebruikt, eveneens beschikbaar is binnen de selfserviceomgeving. De oplossing moet tevens voorzien in passende beheerfunctionaliteit, zodat aangewezen informatiespecialisten zelfstandig datasets, configuraties en publicaties kunnen beheren. Momenteel zijn in de bestaande softwareomgeving meer dan 850 statistische indicatoren beschikbaar, die inclusief metadata moeten kunnen worden gemigreerd. Voor een volledige beschrijving van de opdracht en de bijbehorende voorwaarden en eisen die daaraan worden gesteld, wordt verwezen naar het als Bijlage 1 opgenomen Programma van Eisen.

title: 652-25-111 Repair USP 800 AC-59
TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: SonicCoat
description: Non-Invasive Ultrasonic Coating Evaluation for Electrochemical Systems Makers of fuel cells, electrolyzers and other electrochemical devices depend on catalyst coatings applied with tight consistency; yet, today�s inspection tools force production to pause so samples can be pulled and studied in a laboratory. SonicCoat, developed by researchers at Los Alamos National Laboratory, offers a faster path: A gentle ultrasonic probe reads how much catalyst has been laid down while the coating line keeps running, giving producers real-time confidence in every layer without slowing throughput or harming the part. The payoff is higher yield, more uniform device performance and lower material cost across a platform that reaches from clean-energy hardware to batteries, solar films and semiconductors. How it Works The SonicCoat method rests on a simple physical fact: Sound travels through an object differently as the object�s makeup changes. A small transducer sends acoustic waves through a coated part and listens for the natural tones, or resonances, that the material rings back. As the catalyst is sprayed onto the surface layer by layer, those resonant tones shift in pitch and loudness in step with how much material has been added, so the acoustic signature becomes a fingerprint of coating thickness and uniformity. Because the reading is taken by sound rather than by scraping, cutting or exposing the part to X-rays, the inspection happens in place and in seconds, and the part continues down the line unharmed. Technology Description SonicCoat applies Acoustic Resonance Spectroscopy (ARS) to the quality control of catalyst-coated gas diffusion layers, the porous electrodes at the heart of fuel cells and electrolyzers. A coated sample is held in fixturing fitted with transducers that excite it across a broad frequency band and record its resonant response, first as a baseline on the bare substrate and then after each successive catalyst layer. Comparing each response against the baseline reveals how the resonance peaks migrate and change in amplitude, and those movements track the amount of platinum catalyst deposited. Testing has shown peaks moving roughly in proportion to added catalyst content, which demonstrates enough sensitivity to distinguish layer-by-layer differences in loading. Because the measurement is non-destructive and adds little time to the coating cycle, the approach fits directly into continuous production rather than diverting samples for laboratory analysis by scanning electron microscopy, energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy or X-ray fluorescence, the after-the-fact methods relied on today. Catalyst loading is a primary driver of both cost and performance in electrochemical devices, so verified, consistent deposition translates into steadier power output, longer service life and less wasted precious metal. The same principle extends to any process where a thin coating must be monitored on a substrate, and the technique suits scale-up because it neither caps throughput nor limits the number of parts that can be checked. Advantages Inspects coatings in place while the line keeps moving, with no need to stop and pull samples Fully non-destructive, so parts are never cut, scraped or exposed to X-rays Reads catalyst buildup layer by layer for tight, repeatable quality control Relies on simple, low-cost ultrasonic hardware instead of large laboratory instruments Protects costly materials such as platinum by catching over-coating or under-coating early Scales to high-volume production without limiting output Market Applications Fuel Cell and Electrolyzer Manufacturing Battery Manufacturing Solar Energy Semiconductor Fabrication Protective Coatings TRL 4 U.S. Patent pending LA-UR-26-28073 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. buyer: Transports publics de la région lausannoise sa
title: Switzerland – Industrial machinery – MP 2026.08.865 – Renouvellement des installations de lavage de Perrelet et de la Borde
description: Les Transports publics de la région lausannoise SA (T L) exploitent actuellement des installations de lavage destinées au nettoyage extérieur de leur parc de véhicules sur les sites de Perrelet et de la Borde. Dans le cadre de l'évolution de leur flotte, de l'augmentation des exigences de qualité de lavage et du renouvellement d'équipements arrivés en fin de vie technique, les TL ont décidé de procéder au renouvellement de leurs installations de lavage. Cette démarche vise à garantir la disponibilité à long terme des équipements, à améliorer la qualité du nettoyage des véhicules et à répondre aux besoins futurs de l'exploitation. Le présent appel d'offres porte sur le démontage, la fourniture, la livraison, le montage, les essais, la mise en service, la formation ainsi que les prestations de garantie associées aux nouvelles installations de lavage des dépôts de Perrelet et de la Borde. L'acquisition qui sera mise en concurrence concerne des installations de lavage industrielles destinées au nettoyage de véhicules routiers de transport public, comprenant notamment : * des installations de lavage 2 côtés ; * des installations de lavage 4 côtés ; * des systèmes de lavage sous-châssis ; * des équipements de prélavage et de rinçage ; * des systèmes de production d'eau osmosée ; * des automatismes et systèmes de supervision ; * des interfaces avec les systèmes d'information des T L. Les futures installations devront être compatibles avec l'ensemble du parc de véhicules des T L, y compris les autobus standards, les autobus articulés, les trolleybus articulés, les trolleybus bi-articulés ainsi que les futurs véhicules électriques. Le marché est attribué sous la forme d'un contrat clé en main. Le fournisseur retenu sera responsable de la conception détaillée, de la fabrication, de la fourniture, du montage, des essais, de la mise en service ainsi que de la formation du personnel d'exploitation et de maintenance.

title: Switzerland – Electrical services – Sanierung Fischgängigkeit / Sanierung Kraftwerke / Erneuerung Konzession, SIA Phasen 32-53
description: Das Hauptziel des Projektes ist es, die langfristig und wirtschaftlich nachhaltige Produktion von Erneuerbarer Energie aus Wasserkraft ab ca. 2030 sicherzustellen. Dies umfasst folgende Teilziele: * Die Konzession für die Nutzung der Wasserkraft wird für die Kraftwerke Obertöss und Niedertöss für mindestens weitere 40 Jahre und zu wirtschaftlich tragbaren Rahmenbedingungen gesichert. Zudem muss für den Rückbau der Anlagen nach Konzessionsende eine Rückstellung gebildet werden können. * Die gesetzliche Sanierung der Fischgängigkeit wird erfüllt unter Sicherstellung der vollen Kostenbeteiligung des Bundes. * Der Denkmalschutz wird an den Teilzielen 1) und 2) verbindlich und langfristig geregelt. Eine massvolle Weiterentwicklung und Erneuerung der Kraftwerksanlagen während der Konzessionslaufzeit soll gesichert sein. Als Zwischenziel geht es darum, durch planerische Arbeiten bis und mit Bau- bzw. Konzessionsgesuch rechtlich verbindliche Rahmenbedingungen zu schaffen, so dass die Sanierung und Erneuerung anschliessend entweder selbständig umgesetzt oder aber die Anlagen inkl. dem zugehörigen, rechtssicher genehmigten Projekt verkauft werden können. Daher werden die Phasen 41 – 53 gemäss SIA-Norm 112 nur als Option ausgeschrieben.
